idea: Fuses SD navigation map features with onboard camera BEV features for lane segmentation out to 200 m, reporting over 20 percent higher mIoU than other methods at 50 to 200 m on nuScenes and Argoverse.

title: Mind the map! Accounting for existing map information when estimating online HDMaps from sensor
text: An early prior-informed mapper that tests noisy and outdated priors, the family of Uni-PrevPredMap and PriorDrive; whether the maps are HD or SD is not stated. Query tokens and Hungarian-style matching on a trainable encoder, no route, no abstention, no code. Verdict context; only the three prior-quality levels are reusable for a map-fault sweep.
idea: MapEX uses existing maps of three kinds (minimalist, noisy, outdated) as query tokens and refines the matching used to train query-based map estimators; with noisy maps it reports 38 percent over MapTRv2 on nuScenes.

title: Planning-Oriented End-to-End Autonomous Driving: Architectures, Evaluation, and Emerging Paradigms
text: Background only: it frames whether intermediate representations support route-compliant planning and argues that open-loop displacement metrics are weak evidence, which supports a closed-loop route test for our consumer (E117). Only the abstract was read; how deeply the full text treats route conditioning and map priors is not confirmed. No code. Verdict context; skim the sections on conditional imitation and BEV or vectorised planning.
idea: Survey of planning-oriented end-to-end driving organised by input representation, planning output, supervision and evaluation protocol, from conditional imitation learning to world-model and VLA planners, with the shift from open-loop to closed-loop benchmarks.

title: Learning Orientation Field for OSM-Guided Autonomous Navigation
text: A dense route-direction field on a grid is close to our dense direction field plus a route attribute, and it states robustness to noisy OSM data. Blockers: lidar scans are the input, robot-scale campus data, sampling planners. Verdict not-relevant (lidar); keep the idea of a dense route-direction field as a planner input in mind.
idea: Learns an orientation field that assigns a direction to every map grid cell from lidar scans and OpenStreetMap routes, refined by a network, and plans with Field-RRT star and Field-Bezier on SemanticKITTI and a campus dataset.

title: RHO: Robust Holistic OSM-Based Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization
text: Panorama-to-OSM metric localisation with a large benchmark; the input is ground panoramas, not a BEV raster, and the page gives no uncertainty, lane or route content. Verdict not-relevant (perspective-only); useful only as the source of the CV-RHO benchmark that SeqLoc also uses (dataset not yet released per the README).
idea: Estimates a 3-DoF camera pose by matching holistic panoramas to OpenStreetMap with a two-branch Pin-Pan model and releases the CV-RHO benchmark of over 2.7M images.

title: Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors
text: Identity-initialised repairs trained on the task loss only; inference needs no clean reference, corruption label or temporal history. On KITTI-C the relative corruption error falls 14.07 to 11.92 (MVX-Net); on nuScenes-R the robustness ratio rises only 80.1 to 81.4. Same recipe as our failure fine-tuning on cached features, but detection with separable modality inputs, while ours is one fused 39-channel raster; no code. Verdict watch: compare with PFS (RB01) and reuse the zero-initialised scale trick.
idea: Learns zero-initialised per-channel residual repair modules at the points where a frozen camera-LiDAR detector reads its sensor features, leaving encoders and head untouched.

title: Online Temporal Fusion for Vectorized Map Construction in Mapless Autonomous Driving
text: Fusion on the detection level: per-voxel detection counts (no log-odds), a co-observation matrix as instance evidence, odometry warp without pose-error handling, 16.7 ms per frame on an Orin. Against single-frame MapTR, F1 rises 72.5 to 78.9 (in-house) and 60.1 to 63.8 (Argoverse2). Matches our idea of fusing detections but is raster plus rules and camera-only; new to the catalogue. Verdict watch: swap its counts for clamped log-odds on our heat map as one memory arm.
idea: Fuses historical road-marking detections of an existing network into a hashed sparse semantic voxel map and clusters reliable voxels incrementally into instances with geometry and topology for planning (RA-L 2025).

title: RESBev: Making BEV Perception More Robust
text: Frames robustness as prediction of the next clean BEV state from history and ego motion, the learned version of our hold memory and a sibling of ModalPatch (RB02); handles natural corruption and adversarial attack. The abstract gives no numbers. Blockers: built on the LSS camera pipeline, detection and segmentation only, no code seen. Verdict watch: read the full text for the predictor input (warped history, pose) and whether it works on a fused cached raster.
idea: A plug-in latent world model predicts the clean BEV feature from sequential BEV observations and uses it to repair corrupted inputs, fine-tuned few-shot on an LSS pipeline without changing the backbone.

title: AsyncBEV: Cross-modal Flow Alignment in Asynchronous 3D Object Detection
text: Works on BEV feature maps, our interface: flow-based realignment beats ego-motion compensation alone by 16.6 and 11.9 NDS on dynamic objects at a 0.5 s offset (CMT, UniBEV). Relevant to sensor latency and to the dynamic part of our warp, which assumes a static scene and exact timing. Blockers: detection, LiDAR or camera asynchrony only, needs the known offset, code on mmcv-full 1.6 and mmdet3d 1.0.0rc5. Verdict watch: consider a flow-aligned hold if time offsets enter the failure series.
idea: A lightweight trainable module predicts a dense 2D flow field from asynchronous multi-modal BEV features and the known time offset, then warps the feature maps to align them (ICLR 2026).

title: Delving into Mapping Uncertainty for Mapless Trajectory Prediction
text: A self-supervised gate scales how much the predictor uses map uncertainty from forecast kinematics, plus a covariance matching map geometry; up to 23.6 percent better mapless trajectory prediction on nuScenes. Touches the planner consumer: when to trust vertex uncertainty and validity. Blockers: MapTR and StreamMapNet hosts, prediction not planning, not in the catalogue before; code released. Verdict watch: model for a kinematics-aware confidence gate on route-aware lane tokens.
idea: Shows that the ego kinematic state decides when map uncertainty helps trajectory prediction and adds Proprioceptive Scenario Gating plus a covariance-based map uncertainty (IROS 2025).

title: R4Det: 4D Radar-Camera Fusion for High-Performance 3D Object Detection
text: Relevant part is the gated temporal module: it aligns the previous hidden state with learned offsets because temporal fusion breaks when the ego pose is missing or inaccurate. That targets the pose-error weakness of our ego-warped memory (learned alignment instead of a hard warp). Blockers: detection on VoD and TJ4DRadSet, trained encoder, mmdet3d and CUDA operators, no licence file (README: academic research only). Verdict watch: test learned offsets against our ego-warp under pose noise.
idea: 4D radar-camera detector whose Deformable Gated Temporal Fusion aligns the previous state without ego pose, next to a panoramic depth fusion and an instance-guided refinement (CVPR 2026).

title: B2F-Map: Crowd-sourced Mapping with Bayesian B-spline Fusion
text: Lane lines are spline trajectories whose existence is tracked by a multi-Bernoulli filter: the existence probability is the exact analogue of our validity log-odds, and the spline fusion copes with different vertex density. Offline crowd-sourcing with GNSS and a monocular camera, Gibbs-sampled data association, no code. Verdict context: read the existence update and the spline fusion before the next validity-memory design; no port.
idea: Builds lane maps from monocular fleet data with a Poisson multi-Bernoulli filter for extended-object trajectories on the vehicle and Bayesian fusion of B-splines with Gaussian control points of different density in the cloud (ICRA 2026).

title: NeMO: Neural Map Growing System for Spatiotemporal Fusion in Bird's-Eye-View and BDD-Map Benchmark
text: The learned counterpart of a per-element memory with write access: every BEV cell is updated by the same module, allowing longer sequences and long-range local maps; BDD-Map adds lane, boundary and crossing labels. Relevant to our token and vertex memory update. Blockers: 2023 camera segmentation raster, no venue, no code, abstract-level reading only. Verdict watch: read the update module before designing a learned vertex-memory write.
idea: A readable and writable large map with a learned fusion module and read-write interaction, updated cell by cell by one weight-shared network so that long temporal sequences can be fused.

title: IC-Mapper: Instance-Centric Spatio-Temporal Modeling for Online Vectorized Map Construction
text: Two parts: temporal association of queries across frames and spatial fusion of the current instances with a resampled global map, evaluated with detection, tracking and global-mapping metrics on nuScenes. Touches the memory on instances and its association step. Blockers: query-based camera host in the StreamMapNet environment, tracking metrics not finished in the repository, no licence file. Verdict watch: borrow only the global-map resampling idea.
idea: Matches detection queries of adjacent frames by feature and geometric similarity and merges instances with points sampled from the historical global map (ACM MM 2024).

title: SEF-MAP: Subspace-Decomposed Expert Fusion for Robust Multimodal HD Map Prediction
text: Per-cell variance gate plus distribution-aware masking with surrogate features instead of zeros; reports +4.2 mAP on nuScenes and +4.8 on Argoverse2 on clean data. Touches our failure-trained gate: surrogate-feature masking could replace zeroing when a lost modality is emulated on cached features. Blockers: needs a sensor-separable BEV pair (ours is fused), LiDAR, trained encoder, MapTR-style host, no code. Verdict context: take the masking idea only.
idea: Splits camera-LiDAR BEV features into four subspaces with one expert each, gates experts per BEV cell by predictive variance and trains with masked modalities simulated by EMA surrogate features.

title: MSC-Bench: Benchmarking and Analyzing Multi-Sensor Corruption for Driving Perception
text: Sibling of MapBench (A03) for fused inputs: combined camera-plus-LiDAR corruptions give large drops for map constructors under adverse weather and sensor failure. Gives a protocol for corrupting two sensors at once, which maps to our camera-plus-radar series only by analogy. Blockers: camera-LiDAR, vector-map mAP, no lane graph, not in the catalogue before; the abstract says toolkit and checkpoints are public but shows no link. Verdict context: look at the toolkit for corruption definitions to reuse in the night, blur and camera-off series.
idea: A benchmark of 16 combinations of camera and LiDAR corruptions, alone or together, evaluating six 3D detectors and four HD map constructors.

title: Benchmarking and Improving Bird's Eye View Perception Robustness in Autonomous Driving
text: Extended version of our RB17 (2304.06719) under a new arXiv id. Finds that pre-training, depth-free BEV transformation and long temporal context improve robustness, which supports a temporal memory as an A8 measure. Blockers: camera-oriented, CC BY-NC-SA code on MMDetection3D, and the README does not yet list a map-segmentation benchmark. Verdict context: cite as the newer version of RB17; nothing to port.
idea: TPAMI extension of RoboBEV: 33 BEV models on detection, map segmentation, depth and occupancy under camera corruptions and sensor failures, plus a CLIP-based robustness enhancement.

title: NRSeg: Noise-Resilient Learning for BEV Semantic Segmentation via Driving World Models
text: Evidential deep learning for BEV maps whose classes are not mutually exclusive, the setting of our lane heat map; reports +13.8 percent mIoU unsupervised and +11.4 percent semi-supervised. Gives a route to a per-cell Dirichlet uncertainty on the dense head. Blockers: camera BEV encoder, synthetic-data pipeline, repository without licence file. Verdict context: read the evidential head only when per-cell uncertainty is needed.
idea: Trains a BEV segmentation model with synthetic world-model data, a Dirichlet evidential head next to the multinomial head, and a hierarchical exclusion module for overlapping classes (TIP).

title: Self-Assessment of Evidential Grid Map Fusion for Robust Motion Planning
text: Evidence fusion with an explicit conflict term and a system-level degradation score handed to the planner, the planner-facing side of validity that our log-odds memory lacks. Blockers: LiDAR grids, no learned perception, no numbers on the page, no code. Verdict context: take the idea of reporting a conflict or degradation score next to validity; no port.
idea: Classifies conflicts between LiDAR measurements fused in Subjective Logic evidential grids, computes a degradation score and lets a planner act cautiously under conflict.

title: CodeMerge: Codebook-Guided Model Merging for Robust Test-Time Adaptation in Autonomous Driving
text: Reports +14.9 percent NDS on nuScenes-C and says it also helps online mapping, motion prediction and planning without extra training. The only test-time-adaptation hit for online mapping in this search. Blockers: needs several checkpoints and fingerprints, detection focus, code only in the supplement. Verdict context: not a fit for batch 1 and 31 ms; keep LearnableBN-type adaptation (RB22) as the lighter option.
idea: Merges checkpoints at test time with coefficients from ridge leverage scores over low-dimensional feature fingerprints stored in a key-value codebook.

title: From Fragments to Global Maps: Learning Vectorized Map Aggregation with Large Language Models
text: Aggregation of per-frame detections into one global map without hand-tuned thresholds, trained on corruptions that mimic detector errors (the corruption-as-training-data idea is reusable). It generates polyline tokens with a large language model, so it is token-based and not differentiable to our graph. No code, no latency or numbers on the page. Verdict not-relevant for the chain; read only for the corruption recipe.
idea: MapMergeLLM treats aggregation of noisy overlapping local vector-map predictions along a trajectory as sequence generation by an LLM trained on synthetic corrupted maps with a line-level association loss.

title: FlexMap: Robust HD Map Construction under Flexible Camera Configurations
text: Robust to missing views and pose errors on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 without per-configuration retraining; separates spatial reasoning from temporal aggregation. It lives entirely in the camera encoder and decoder, which our frozen cached raster cannot use. No numbers on the abstract page, no code. Verdict not-relevant; at most a missing-view test protocol.
idea: Replaces explicit 2D-to-BEV projection by a geometry foundation model and a camera-aware decoder so that one model handles missing cameras and poor poses without camera parameters.

title: SparseLaneSTP: Leveraging Spatio-Temporal Priors with Sparse Transformers for 3D Lane Detection
text: Uses geometry priors and past lane observations to help in poor visibility, with a temporal regularisation term. It works on perspective images, with separate lane lines instead of a graph with forks and merges, and shows no code link. Verdict not-relevant: perspective-only; the temporal regularisation is only a loose analogue of our consistency ideas.
idea: A sparse-transformer 3D lane detector with lane-specific spatio-temporal attention, a continuous lane representation, temporal regularisation and a new automatically labelled 3D lane dataset (ICCV 2025).
